notes.title: Finally good faceoff dynamics!
notes.content:
- Faceoffs for Hockey map and Square map now shoot into the corner of the scoring team. This eliminates easy goals when both teams are charging at the puck
- Slight nerf to Advanced and Pro AI
- Slightly shorter career mode

notes.title: Welcome to Gravityball!
notes.content:
First off, let me apologize by taking so long before welcoming my small community of Gravityball players.

I hope you're all enjoying the game!  I'll probably continue to push out small updates for a while and would love to get feedback on what you like about the game, what needs work, and what you'd like to see added.

Good riding!
